main.ap.description: entry, title→game→end flow, frame loop (ply_handle → main_turn → ren_draw → ui_draw → present → sleep), new game/floor, climbing

src/defs.ap.description: shared .define constants only: sizes, record layouts, regions, palette, keys, tuning

src/state.ap.description: all shared game state (data only) incl. the 100x30 display block

src/rng.ap.description: uniform random range helper over the 16-bit LCC+ RNG (high-bit extraction)

src/dungeon.ap.description: floor generation (rooms, corridors, doors, stairs), tile get/set, walkable/opaque, random floor tiles, distance

src/fov.ap.description: field of view (visible + remembered maps), line of sight between two points

src/parts.ap.description: part catalog, loadout slots, inventory, attach/detach, derived stats, energy, self-repair, damage spread over parts and core

src/ui.ap.description: panel, bars, loadout/inventory/target lists, message ring (ui_msg*), help row, menus, help overlay, title/death/win screens

src/render.ap.description: map viewport: tiles by visibility, items, enemies, player, target highlight

src/items.ap.description: floor item pool: place, find at, remove, per-floor loot

src/actors.ap.description: enemy types, enemy pool, spawning per depth, action-time scheduler, AI (distance field), target cycling

src/combat.ap.description: hit chance, player fire/melee, enemy attacks, robot destruction and drops

src/player.ap.description: input modes and player actions: move/bump, wait, pickup, equip/remove/drop menus, targeting + fire, stairs, help, quit prompt
